changelog:
Major update with new export options, batch processing, and Python integration.

- Added support for IFC2x3, IFC4, and IFC4.3 export versions with customizable settings.
- No Autodesk license required; conversion runs fully offline.
- Batch processing for automatic conversion of multiple RVT files.
- Standardized export presets (standard, extended, custom) and detailed CLI usage documentation.
- Python API for automation, config generation, batch conversion, and basic IFC file validation.
- Introduced IFC export quality checker and validation utilities.
summary: Convert RVT files to IFC format. Support IFC2x3, IFC4, IFC4.3 with customizable export settings.
